d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Costa Rica vs Brazil in Group I of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Brazil completed a perfect group stage with a 3-0 win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Rodrigo Jr broke the deadlock after the break, Kaue Furquim converted a penalty and Lucas Emanuel added a third. Brazil top Group I with nine points, while Costa Rica exit the tournament.
